scope: Small validation: 54 episodes, six language goals, instruction/layout counterfactual on seed31101, frozen controller and VLM. Development seed31001 excluded. Not a superiority or open-vocabulary claim.
call_budget_definition: One text-only VLM instruction parsing call and up to five image-grounding calls per episode, shared across non-oracle modes.
primary_outcome: correct language predicate and accepted visual goal, executing it, full SO(3) error <= 0.16 rad, no drop; evaluator termination; no hold
state_pairing: Fresh simulator per scenario/mode; compare reset object rotation/position/proprio/layout. Rendering need not be bitwise identical.
